title: Ranges and NOT in sale_items · part 4

steps.title: Keep sale_id from 2 to 3
steps.prompt:
BETWEEN lo AND hi keeps a range (both ends included).
It is a tidy way to write two comparisons at once.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE sale_id BETWEEN …
Write the two ends with AND between them.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3;
steps.memory_trick: BETWEEN a AND b = a <= x <= b.

steps.title: Keep sale_id outside 2..3
steps.prompt: NOT flips a test: NOT (something) means 'the opposite'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Wrap the range in brackets after NOT.
NOT ( sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3 ).
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (sale_id BETWEEN 2 AND 3);
steps.memory_trick: NOT reverses whatever is inside the brackets.
